verdict.rationale: Event hooks deliver outbound HTTPS REST calls when specified events occur, a webhook-style push of identity events. The official MCP server's example of querying failed login attempts from the last 24 hours implies login events can be queried through the admin APIs. However, the pack has no documentation of a structured System Log, its query or export API, or native SIEM streaming integrations. missing for 10: documented structured system log schema, a log query/export API reference, native SIEM log streaming (e.g. named SIEM connectors), retention/export details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
